subject: Post-call: Zenbridge inference discovery — SLOs & deployment qualifiers
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@zenbridge.ai>, Priyanka Rao <pri@zenbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Zenbridge inference discovery — SLOs & deployment qualifiers

Hi Carlos / Priyanka — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the bits we promised to capture: 

Pain points you reiterated
- End-user latency spikes during peak batch processing (periodic 95th-percentile > 800ms for 512-token requests).
- High per-token costs from your current endpoint strategy when traffic is bursty.
- Needing stronger isolation/certification (SOC2 evidence + audit logs) for PII flows.

Goals you outlined
- 95th-pctl tail latency target: <= 150ms for typical chat messages (~64 tokens), and <= 400ms for longer generative calls (512 tokens).
- Sustained throughput target: 120 QPS steady-state for routing-critical flows with headroom for 300 QPS bursts.
- Pilot window: 6 weeks starting mid-November; production target Q1 2028.

Model & workload notes we captured
- Primary model: open-replica (Llama-3-70B-AVX) quantized to int8 for cost/perf tradeoff.
- Prompt archetypes: short chat (64 tokens), document summarization (512–1k tokens), embed-only search pipelines.

Topology options discussed
1) Redwood Dedicated (preferred): dedicated GPU pool in us-west, reserved capacity (predictable throughput + VPC peering).
2) Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC): for stricter data residency — longer lead time, full audit logs.
3) Hosted fallback: streamed endpoints + prefix caching for low-latency non-sensitive traffic.

Open technical questions (please confirm):
- Is the 120 QPS steady-state per-region or global? (We assumed per-region/us-west.)
- Can you share 1 week of anonymized p95/p50 latency & token histogram so we can size batching/kv-cache?
- Any hard limits on model size or no-gos for int8 quantization?

Next steps we propose (mutual action items)
- Redwood: produce a topology sketch + estimated cost delta (Dedicated vs Hosted) by Oct 7. (Owner: me)
- Zenbridge: share a redacted traffic sample + SOC2 evidence ask list by Oct 8. (Owner: Carlos)
- Redwood Sales: pricing sketch for a 6-week pilot + token cap option. (Owner: Marissa)

Attached: quick post-call notes, latency profiling template, and a draft mutual action plan.

If anything above is off, flag and I’ll update. Otherwise we’ll treat Oct 7/8 as the target for those deliverables.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: zenbridge_postcall_notes.pdf (summary), zenbridge_latency-profiling-template.xlsx (sample), zb_mutual_action_plan_v1.docx

Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Zenbridge inference discovery — SLOs & deployment qualifiers

Thanks, Sean — solid write-up, appreciate the clarity. Quick confirmations and a couple of clarifying items: 

Confirmations:
- 120 QPS is per-region (US-west primary). Bursts can hit 300 QPS for short windows (1–5 minutes) tied to batch jobs.
- The 95th targets you captured align with our internal goals; our immediate concern is the 512-token path which currently spikes unpredictably.

Clarifying items:
- We can provide a redacted 7-day token and latency histogram by Oct 8 — I’ll have that to you.
- Data residency: customer PII must remain in our VPC for the pilot — we’d prefer Redwood Dedicated with VPC peering for the pilot. Is that feasible for a 6-week pilot?
- Model quantization: our ML team is comfortable testing int8 on a staging copy; final decision depends on quality regressions measured in your eval harness.

Small ask: can you include a rough throughput vs. cost table for 120/200/300 QPS on a per-hour basis? We want to present that to finance Monday.

Hey team — looping in quick commercial framing while Sean and engineering size the topology. A few practical options we can propose for the 6-week pilot: 

1) Dedicated pilot (recommended):
- Fixed monthly commit for 2x GPUs (A100-class equiv) with burst credits to handle 300 QPS spikes.
- Pilot commercial: $18k/week (6-week total $108k) including standard support & onboarding.
- Includes SOC2 evidence export + 30 days extended logs retention.

2) Hosted + reserved buffer:
- Lower entry: $9k/week (6-week total $54k) with soft isolation and streaming endpoint for non-PII flows.
- Data residency requires VPC peering add-on for the pilot (+1 week lead time).

Add-ons:
- Eval suite run (quality regression tests across int8) — $6k one-time.
- Dedicated SRE hours for cutover/week of pilot — $2k/week.

If Dedicated looks aligned, we can draft an LOI and have it ready for signature + provisioning timeline (2–3 weeks) after LOI.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
